# garage_cluster_health (Data Source)

Health of the cluster as seen by the node behind the endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_cluster_health" "this" {}

check "garage_healthy" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.garage_cluster_health.this.status == "healthy"
    error_message = "Garage is ${data.garage_cluster_health.this.status}."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `connected_nodes` (Number)
- `known_nodes` (Number)
- `partitions` (Number)
- `partitions_all_ok` (Number)
- `partitions_quorum` (Number)
- `status` (String) `healthy`, `degraded` or `unavailable`.
- `storage_nodes` (Number)
- `storage_nodes_up` (Number)
